import ctypes
import numpy as np

# Load the libraries
ctypes.CDLL('/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgslcblas.so', mode=ctypes.RTLD_GLOBAL)
gsl = ctypes.CDLL('/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgsl.so')

# Define the function prototype
cblas_ztpsv = ctypes.CDLL('/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgslcblas.so').cblas_ztpsv
cblas_ztpsv.argtypes = [ctypes.c_int, ctypes.c_int, ctypes.c_int, ctypes.c_int, ctypes.c_int, ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_double), ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_double), ctypes.c_int]
cblas_ztpsv.restype = None

# Define enums for CBLAS_ORDER, CBLAS_UPLO, CBLAS_TRANSPOSE, CBLAS_DIAG
CBLAS_ORDER = {'RowMajor': 101, 'ColMajor': 102}
CBLAS_UPLO = {'Upper': 121, 'Lower': 122}
CBLAS_TRANSPOSE = {'NoTrans': 111, 'Trans': 112, 'ConjTrans': 113}
CBLAS_DIAG = {'NonUnit': 131, 'Unit': 132}

# Function to perform the operation
def triangular_packed_matrix_vector(order, uplo, transA, diag, N, Ap, X, incX):
    Ap_ctypes = Ap.ctypes.data_as(ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_double))
    X_ctypes = X.ctypes.data_as(ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_double))
    cblas_ztpsv(CBLAS_ORDER[order], CBLAS_UPLO[uplo], CBLAS_TRANSPOSE[transA], CBLAS_DIAG[diag], N, Ap_ctypes, X_ctypes, incX)
    return X

# Test cases
def assert_test():
    # Test case 1
    N = 2
    Ap = np.array([1+1j, 2+2j, 3+3j], dtype=np.complex128).view(np.float64)
    X = np.array([4+4j, 5+5j], dtype=np.complex128).view(np.float64)
    incX = 1
    result = triangular_packed_matrix_vector('ColMajor', 'Upper', 'NoTrans', 'NonUnit', N, Ap, X, incX).view(np.complex128)
    expected = np.array([0.66666667+0.j, 1.66666667+0.j], dtype=np.complex128)  # Expected result after operation
    assert np.allclose(result, expected), f"Test case 1 failed: {result} != {expected}"

if __name__ == "__main__":
    assert_test()
